sections.changelog:
1.4.0

  • ## 1.4.0
  • **Security**
  • Password policy (length, character mix, breached-password check), sign-out after inactivity, session limit.
  • Require two-factor by role with a grace period.
  • Content Security Policy (report-only or enforce) with a violation list.
  • **Performance**
  • Heartbeat/revision/autosave controls were already in 1.3; new: preconnect hints, Speculation Rules, asset removal by handle, database cleanup and autoload report, compression/caching snippets.
  • **Tools**
  • WP-CLI commands (`wp refinelab ...`).
  • Diagnostics page: cron manager, debug log viewer, optional e-mail log.
  • Live database search & replace (dry run first), admin bar shortcuts.
  • **HTML blocks and editor**
  • Placeholder filters (`{{ x | upper }}`), number/radio/date/image controls, menu/query/post meta/terms context.
  • Partials, variations, template check with usage report.
  • Per-field typography and spacing, visibility per device, copy/paste block settings, outlines, command palette commands, accessibility check panel.
  • Docs in English and Traditional Chinese are updated.
